description:
Conquest Isles is a single-player real-time strategy game about capturing islands.
Tap one of your islands, then tap a destination to dispatch half its forces. Capture neutral islands and eliminate the opposing faction to win.

Features
• Random battlefields with 6, 8, 10, or 12 islands
• Four CPU difficulty levels, from Very Easy to Hard
• CPU-versus-CPU spectator mode with separate difficulty settings for both sides
• Pause at any time and play again with the same settings
• Available in English and Japanese
• No account registration, ads, or in-app purchases

Forces grow over time. Read the battlefield, balance attacks and reinforcements, and account for travel time. Every short match takes place on a different island layout, giving you new strategic choices each time.
